newsitem.title: USA: U.S. industry keeps growing steadily in June.
newsitem.headline: U.S. industry keeps growing steadily in June.

text.p: Production by U.S. mines, factories and utilities kept growing steadily in June, the Federal Reserve said on Wednesday, boosted by stronger output of new cars, aircraft and computers.
Overall industrial production increased 0.3 percent last month after a 0.2 percent May gain as industries once again ran at 83.5 percent of their maximum operating capacity, the same as in May.

"Continued strength in commercial aircraft and the high-technology sector again contributed importantly to the growth of output," the Fed said, as did a rebound in motor vehicle production from strike-depressed levels in April and May.
